newsitem.title: USA: Investors file suit against IMP Inc.
newsitem.headline: Investors file suit against IMP Inc.

text.p: Law firm Berman, DeValerio & Pease LLP said Monday it had filed a class action suit against IMP Inc on behalf of a group of shareholders for allegedly releasing false information about its business operations.
The firm said it filed the suit in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware on December 2 on behalf of investors who had bought common stock in the company between April 24 and July 22.
The firm said that IMP and four of its officers apparently misrepresented material information concerning its business operations.
The shareholder group alleges that the information had "artificially inflated" the price of the company's stock.
IMP officials were not immediately available for comment, the firm said.
